questions.q_en: The difference between upstream speed of boat A and boat B is 5 km/hr and the sum of their speeds in still water is 45 km/hr. What is the speed of boat B in still water?
questions.solution_en:
Let speed of boat A in still water = a km/hr

Speed of boat B in still water = b km/hr

Stream speed = s km/hr

Upstream speed of boat A = a - s

Downstream speed of boat B = b - s

a + b = 45

a = 45 - b

The difference between upstream speed of boat A and boat B is 5 km/hr.

Case 1:

(a - s) - (b - s) = 5

a = 5 + b = 45 - b

b = 25 km/hr

Case 2:

(b - s) - (a - s) = 5

a = b - 5 = 45 - b

b = 20 km/hr

questions.q_en: If the radius of a circle becomes 12 times, then how many times will its circumference become?
questions.solution_en:
Let the radius be 'r'

The circumference of the circle = 2πr

New radius = 12r

The new circumference = 2π(12r)

Hence, the required value = [2π*12r]/[2πr]

= 12 times

questions.q_en: If the area of the bigger circle is 3773/2 cm2 and the difference between the circumference of the bigger circle and the smaller circle is 66 cm, then find the area of the smaller circle.
questions.solution_en:
The area of the bigger circle = π * radius2

3773/2 = 22/ 7 * radius2

radius2 = 600.25

radius = 24.5

So, the radius of a bigger circle = 24.5 cm

Difference between the circumference of the bigger circle and the smaller circle = 66 cm

2π (24.5 - radius of a smaller circle) = 66

24.5 - radius of a smaller circle = (66 * 7)/ (22 * 2)

The radius of a smaller circle = 24.5 - 10.5 = 14 cm

Hence, the area of the smaller circle = π * 14 * 14 = 616 cm2

questions.q_en:
P and Q take part in 400 m race. P runs at 12 km/hr. P gives Q a start of 20 m and still beats him by 13 seconds. The speed of Q is:

(Round up to two decimal places.)
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by P to complete the race = (400/1000)/(12) = 1/30 hours

Time taken by Q to complete the race = 1/30 + 13/3600 = 133/3600 hours

Distance covered by Q = 400 - 20 = 380 m = 0.38 km

Speed of Q = 0.38/(133/3600) = 10.29 km/hr

questions.q_en: Arun goes 6 km against the current of a stream in 1 hour, and 5 km along the current in 20 minutes. How long will it take him to go 21 km in stationary water?
questions.solution_en:
Upstream speed of Arun = 6/1 = 6 kmph

Downstream speed of Arun = 5/ (1/3) = 15 kmph

Speed of Arun in stationary water = (1/2) * [Downstream speed + upstream speed]

= (1/2) * 21 = 10.5 kmph

Time taken by him to cover 21 km in stationary water = 21/10.5 = 2 hours

questions.q_en: In ∆GHJ, HJ is parallel to KL and GK: KH = 3: 11 and GL = 27 cm. What is the difference between the length of LJ and GL?
questions.solution_en:
In ∆GKL and ∆GHJ, we have,

HJ is parallel to KL, therefore -

∠GKL = ∠GHJ

∠GLK = ∠GJH

And ∠KGL = ∠HGJ (common angle)

Thus, ∆GKL and ∆GHJ are similar triangles.

So, applying similar triangle property.

GK/GH = GL/GJ = KL/HJ

3/14 = 27/(27 + LJ)

=> 81 + 3 LJ = 14 * 27

=> LJ = 297/3

=> LJ = 99

So, difference = 99 - 27 = 72 cm

questions.q_en: Boat A covers 24 km more distance than boat B while travelling downstream in 12 hours. The sum of upstream and downstream speed of boat A is 44 km/hr. Find the average of speed of boat A and boat B in still water.
questions.solution_en:
Let speed of boat A and boat B in still water are 'a' km/hr and 'b' km/hr respectively and stream is flowing with speed 's' km/hr.

Upstream speed of boat A = a - s

Downstream speed of boat A = a + s

Downstream speed of boat B = b + s

a + s + a - s = 44

a = 22 km/hr

Boat A covers 28 km more distance than boat B while travelling downstream, i.e.,

(a + s)12 - (b + s)12 = 24

b = a - 2 = 22 - 2 = 20 km/hr

Average = (22 + 20)/2 = 21 km/hr

questions.q_en: Two trains, one 150 m and the other 100 m long, are traveling towards each other on parallel tracks at speeds of 54 km/h and 36 km/h respectively. How many seconds will they take to completely pass each other?
questions.solution_en:
Length of Train A = 150 m

Length of Train B = 100 m

Total distance to clear = 150 + 100 = 250 m

Speed of Train A = 54 km/h = 54 X (5/18) = 15 m/s

Speed of Train B = 36 km/h = 36 X (5/18) = 10 m/s

Since they move in opposite directions, relative speed = 15 + 10 = 25 m/s

Time to pass = [Total distance] / [Relative speed] = 250 / 25 = 10 seconds

Thus, they take 10 seconds to pass each other completely.
